title: GPT-6 Astra feels like a step function
author: lorean_victor
selftext:
so I was in a meeting today, and it was dragging a bit, so during it I asked codex to make a survivorslike vibe with a dual slinging cowboy and some demons. it quickly did a [basic outliny version](https://vibed.city/preview/01a07643-f739-7c02-82e8-fdca008ce007), which did the trick but required a bit tuning (as they always do). just to try out new capabilities of astra, I asked it to make it more realistic. and it basically made whats in the video ([you can play it here](https://vibed.city/e/01a07695-f0cb-7d89-981d-e67d16da5d40)), all on its own volition (of course it burnt through my hourly limits like crazy too). the end result needed a bit of tuning for balance but that was it. and I'm just awestruck.

like I didn't even specify much, just said "please make it a bit more realistic and grim", hoping for a few more details than just circles and what not. idk man I know its a bit expensive right now, but I can't just help but imagine about the possibilities. all the game ideas that I've had across the years can now be relatively cheaply and quickly made into reality, which is quite exciting!
